title: Roveia floating nav (v2)
description: A white pill nav floating 24px from the top of the window with a soft shadow: plain wordmark left, five links centre (dropdowns open a small white card on hover or focus), and an ink pill button with an arrow that turns blue on hover. On phones a narrower pill with a two-line burger that opens a white card of links.
notes: position: fixed, so it floats over the page; put it first on the page
dropdowns and the phone menu are CSS / <details>, no JavaScript needed
